rationale: The only implementation delta is the name-copy operation: the vulnerable version uses an unbounded strcpy, while the fixed version uses bounded nla_strlcpy with TIPC_MAX_LINK_NAME. The Logic section states only that the nested attributes are parsed to extract the link name and that the resulting information is added as a TLV. Those claims hold for both versions and do not specify the copy mechanism, length handling, or any safety check.
